data.name: Silence Master
data.description: You are able to activate spell trigger, spell completion, and command word items silently, substituting a magical gesture for the necessary words. You must be able to make somatic gestures, and know how to activate the item normally. 3/day, you may also cast a spell of 6th level or lower as if using a silent metamagic rod.
